name: pdq-node
description: Node.js native addon for merging and splitting PDF files, built on the pdq Rust crate.

scripts.build:native: napi build --platform --release --manifest-path Cargo.toml --output-dir native --js index.js --dts index.d.ts
scripts.build:native:debug: napi build --platform --manifest-path Cargo.toml --output-dir native --js index.js --dts index.d.ts
scripts.build: pnpm run build:native && pnpm run build:ts
scripts.build:debug: pnpm run build:native:debug && pnpm run build:ts
